rules: Strict is the additive weighted completion of ten independent financial-review responsibilities. The 25% decision owner is largest because the committee call is the delivered decision; profiles and debt-purpose each receive 15% because they prevent a plausible ratio screen from becoming a misleading financing conclusion; CIP and goodwill receive 10% each because both can reverse the economic interpretation of expansion; method, calibration, signed-profit, missingness and structure each receive 5% because they are necessary controls but do not replace the company-level decision. Source arithmetic limits only the affected responsibility and never multiplies unrelated owners. Lenient requires exact source-universe coverage, source-correct displayed metrics, calls coherent with the candidate's disclosed policy, and three independent business-completion checks. Infrastructure errors are unmeasured and never candidate zeros.
